title: Enabling and Accessing Actuator Endpoints
description: Add the Actuator starter and expose built‑in endpoints.

slides.title: Add the Starter 📦
slides.content:
# Dependencies

In your `pom.xml`, add:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
    <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

Now restart your app. By default, only the `/health` and `/info` endpoints are exposed over HTTP.

quizData.question: Which endpoints are exposed by default when you add the Actuator starter?
quizData.explanation: For security, only /health and /info are exposed by default. You can enable others via configuration.

slides.title: Enabling All Endpoints
slides.content:
In `application.properties`, you can enable all endpoints (or select specific ones):

```properties
# Enable all Actuator endpoints
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=*

# Or enable specific ones
management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info,metrics,env

# Exclude certain endpoints
management.endpoints.web.exposure.exclude=env
```

Now visit `http://localhost:8080/actuator` – you'll see a list of available endpoints.

slides.title: Actuator Base Path
slides.content: All Actuator endpoints are mounted under `/actuator` by default. You can change this with `management.endpoints.web.base-path=/manage`.
